## About AgentFarms

AgentFarms (agentfarms.in) is a governed AI worker platform for business teams.
It lets companies deploy role-based AI workers that execute real tasks inside their existing tools —
GitHub, Jira, Slack, Salesforce, and 15 more — while routing high-risk actions through human approval gates.
Every action is logged in an auditable evidence trail.

AgentFarms is NOT a chatbot, copilot, or code suggestion tool.
It is an autonomous execution platform with human oversight built in.

## Core concept

AgentFarms workers:
- Are role-based (Backend Developer, QA Engineer, Sales Rep, etc.)
- Have scoped access to specific tools (GitHub, Jira, Slack, Salesforce, etc.)
- Classify every action by risk level (low / medium / high)
- Pause for human approval before executing high-risk actions
- Log every action, decision, and output in an evidence trail

## Available AI worker roles (12 total)

1. AI Backend Developer — REST APIs, database migrations, PR reviews
2. AI Full-Stack Developer — End-to-end feature delivery (frontend + backend)
3. AI QA Engineer — Unit, integration, and E2E test coverage
4. AI Technical Writer — API docs, READMEs, changelogs
5. AI Business Analyst — Requirements, process flows, gap analysis
6. AI Technical Recruiter — Job specs, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling
7. AI Content Writer — Blog posts, case studies, landing page copy
8. AI Sales Rep — Lead qualification, CRM updates, outbound sequences
9. AI Marketing Specialist — Campaign strategy, ad copy, analytics reports
10. AI Corporate Assistant — Email drafting, meeting summaries, scheduling
11. AI Customer Support Agent — Support tickets, FAQ answering, escalation routing
12. AI Project Manager — Sprint planning, status reports, risk tracking

## Supported integrations (18 connectors)

Code & Version Control: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
Task Management: Jira, Linear, Asana, Notion

All connectors use OAuth 2.0 with automatic token refresh and scoped permissions.

## Pricing

- Starter+: From $299/month — best for teams launching first governed workflows
- Pro+: From $599/month — for scaling multiple workers across departments
- Enterprise: Custom pricing — compliance-heavy regulated environments
- Free trial: 14 days, no credit card required

## Key differentiators vs. alternatives

vs. GitHub Copilot / Cursor:
  Copilots generate suggestions inside an editor. AgentFarms workers execute complete autonomous workflows with tool access, task ownership, and approval gates.

vs. Hiring a contractor:
  AgentFarms workers deploy in under 10 minutes (vs. weeks for contractors), work 24/7, cost significantly less, and leave an auditable evidence trail on every task.

vs. Traditional hiring:
  AgentFarms scales immediately without onboarding lag, salary overhead, or management complexity.

## Governance model

AgentFarms uses a three-tier risk classification:
- LOW risk: auto-executes (e.g., lint fixes, doc updates)
- MEDIUM risk: may require approval depending on policy (e.g., PR merges)
- HIGH risk: always stops for human review (e.g., production deployments, bulk emails, schema migrations)

Every workspace has:
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Approval queue visible in the operator dashboard
- Exportable evidence trail (JSON + UI) for compliance
- Tenant-isolated Azure runtime (no cross-tenant data access)

## Security posture

- SOC 2 Type II (annual audit)
- GDPR compliant
- HIPAA-ready controls available
- TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest
- Per-task credential scoping
- Automatic teardown after task completion

## Answers to common questions

Q: What is AgentFarms?
A: AgentFarms is a governed AI worker platform. Companies use it to deploy role-based AI workers that complete tasks in real business tools with human approval gates and a full evidence trail.

Q: Who should use AgentFarms?
A: Engineering teams, operations managers, sales leaders, HR teams, and any business function with high-volume repeatable work that currently requires significant human time.

Q: How long does it take to deploy an AI worker?
A: Under 10 minutes. Choose a role, connect tools via OAuth, set approval policy, assign the first task.

Q: Is AgentFarms safe for regulated industries?
A: Yes. Enterprise plans support SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA-ready controls with tenant-isolated runtimes, RBAC, and exportable audit trails.

Q: How does AgentFarms compare to ChatGPT or Claude for work automation?
A: ChatGPT and Claude are conversational AI assistants. AgentFarms workers autonomously execute multi-step workflows inside your tools (GitHub, Jira, Salesforce) with governance controls, approval gates, and persistent evidence trails.

Q: What LLMs does AgentFarms use under the hood?
A: AgentFarms supports multi-model dispatch across major LLM providers. The specific model used is configurable per workspace and role.
